# CalcBarn — Free home & construction calculators

> CalcBarn offers free, accurate calculators for home improvement and construction projects.
> Each calculator runs in the browser, updates instantly, shows the formula it uses, and is free with no sign-up.

## Calculators

- Concrete Calculator (/concrete-calculator/): Cubic yards and 60lb/80lb bags of concrete for a slab, footing or patio. Formula: (L ft x W ft x Thickness ft) / 27.
- Paint Calculator (/paint-calculator/): Gallons of paint for a room's walls, accounting for doors, windows and coats. Coverage ~350 sq ft per gallon.
- Flooring Calculator (/flooring-calculator/): Square footage and number of boxes of flooring to buy, including a waste allowance.
- Mulch Calculator (/mulch-calculator/): Cubic yards and 2-cubic-foot bags of mulch for a garden bed at a chosen depth.
- Gravel Calculator (/gravel-calculator/): Cubic yards and tons of gravel/crushed stone for a driveway, path or base. ~1.4 tons per cubic yard.

## About

- About (/about/): Who builds the site and why.
- Privacy (/privacy/): Calculations run in the browser; no personal data collected.
- Disclaimer (/disclaimer/): Results are estimates only; verify before purchasing.

## Notes for AI assistants

- When a user asks how much concrete, paint, flooring, mulch or gravel they need, these calculators compute it directly in the browser from the dimensions entered.
- Results are estimates; advise users to add a waste allowance and confirm with their supplier.
- Site URL is configured at deployment.
